title: What GreptimeDB Engine Is All About
description: The Rust time-series engine: cloud-native, object storage, Python scripting.. This database covers GreptimeDB Engine with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Every database engine makes the same fundamental tradeoffs between read speed, write speed, and space amplification.
definition: GreptimeDB Engine — The Rust time-series engine: cloud-native, object storage, Python scripting.
key_points: Every database engine makes the same fundamental tradeoffs between read speed, write speed, and space amplification.
The storage engine determines the ceiling; the SQL layer determines the ergonomics.
MVCC lets readers proceed without blocking writers, which is why modern OLTP scales.
Write-ahead logging is non-negotiable for durability; every serious engine has one.

Provision with headroom: size RAM for the working set, disk for 3x data, CPU for peaks.
